Method of Attack: Break secrecy of Bluetooth sessions allowing device impersonation and man-in-the-middle (MitM) attacks
Exploits flaws in Bluetooth session key derivation to force weak and predictable session keys
Brute-forces session keys to decrypt past and manipulate future communications
Impersonates one device to negotiate weak session keys with another
Impacted Systems: Bluetooth devices running Bluetooth Core Specification 4.2 through 5.4
Attack Vector: Within Bluetooth wireless range of target devices
